svg.title: A sign-in window, not a browser
svg.desc: Umbra's sign-in window lists each account and whether it is signed in, with Sign In, Sign Out and Add Account. It checks each site without loading it. For a site it can check, it shows the page only to sign in, checks every page before it appears, and closes the page the moment the sign-in lands, so the window can't be used to browse. Add Account takes a pasted login link; after the first sign-in (ended with Done) it learns the account's sign-in cookie and checks it like the others.
